qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.lowering: The word subtraction uses one restartable scalar read and keeps its flags lazy until the qword store materializes them. The final store uses the existing transactional write callback.
admission.boundedRule: The measured RIP, complete 11-byte/two-instruction block, R12/RSP/RCX registers, widths, and both stack displacements must all match. An adjacent RIP or changed read displacement declines.

verification.focusedGate: The exact slab-free block passes successful and rejected-write tier-one execution cases.
verification.dbtPCAndRunnerGate: 1,493 tests in 175 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: A nontrivial R12 upper value, word subtraction, complete flags, RCX qword store, final RIP, and full memory image match the interpreter.
verification.faultCoverage: A forced final-write rejection returns the tier-one interpreter exit with complete block-entry state and memory unchanged after exactly one write attempt.
verification.negativeCoverage: An adjacent RIP and a mutated source displacement both decline tier one.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The executions have different interrupt, compilation, trace, address-space, and instruction totals. Exact-site absence establishes production use; aggregate and elapsed movements are reported for completeness and are not a performance claim.

nextVisibleSites.note: The live alternatives-patched prefix differs from the previously admitted LOCK-prefixed static instruction and remains a separate boundary.

interpretation: The exact 3,687-hit mixed read/write block is absent from the candidate's capped live negative-cache sample. A05.2 remains open because 116,572 of 217,968 tier-one attempts still decline.
limitations: The complete workload evidence contains one candidate run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
The negative-cache sampler is capped and proves absence only from the retained visible list.
This evidence establishes no statistical performance delta and does not satisfy G1-G5.
